safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the absence of unwell contacts slightly reduces epidemiologic context (e.g., household/close-contact transmission) but does not materially change evaluation or management of an uncomplicated URTI presentation. The denial of nausea/vomiting was still captured, so clinical impact is minimal.
